result:
The fix for TRUNK-6646 is commit `e7052745fb78802c8adcd7c1962f3525e7050b1e` ("Env-var key normalization drops create_database_* / create_user_* credentials in scripted setup", PR #6145, by jwnasambu, 2026-06-12).

**Root cause:** `InitializationFilter` copies every environment variable into the script properties under a normalized key. Unless the key is on a whitelist, `normalizeEnvVariableKey` lowercases it and turns `_` into `.`. So `CREATE_DATABASE_USERNAME` became `create.database.username`, and the lookup for `create_database_username` missed it. The wizard then kept its default of `root` with no password (the default is noted at `openmrs-core/web/src/main/java/org/openmrs/web/filter/initialization/InitializationFilter.java:549`), which produced the "Access denied" failure.

**The fix:** the commit adds the affected keys to `NON_NORMALIZED_KEYS`. These are `CREATE_DATABASE_USERNAME`, `CREATE_DATABASE_PASSWORD`, `CREATE_USER_USERNAME`, `CREATE_USER_PASSWORD`, plus `CONNECTION_DRIVER_CLASS`, `IMPORT_TEST_DATA`, `REMOTE_URL`, `REMOTE_USERNAME`, `REMOTE_PASSWORD` and `ADMIN_PASSWORD_LOCKED`. It also reads `connection_driver_class` and `import_test_data`/`add_demo_data` from the script, reads the remote settings, and copies all `property.*` entries from the merged `script` rather than from `installScript`. The whitelist change is the core of the fix. The other changes come along with it in the same commit.

I confirmed the whitelist and method at their current line numbers in the checkout. The new unit tests in `InitializationFilterNormalizationTest.java` and `InitializationFilterTest.java` cover the behaviour. I did not run the tests.

Evidence, best first:
- `openmrs-core/web/src/main/java/org/openmrs/web/filter/initialization/InitializationFilter.java:197-201`: the whitelist that now includes the create-database and create-user keys
- `openmrs-core/web/src/main/java/org/openmrs/web/filter/initialization/InitializationFilter.java:1948-1953`: `normalizeEnvVariableKey`, which skips lowercasing and dot conversion only for whitelisted keys
- `openmrs-core/web/src/main/java/org/openmrs/web/filter/initialization/InitializationFilter.java:340-343`: environment variables are merged into the script properties through that normalizer
- `openmrs-core/web/src/main/java/org/openmrs/web/filter/initialization/InitializationFilter.java:370-372`: the script reads `create_database_username` and `create_database_password`, which the old normalization never produced
- `openmrs-core/web/src/main/java/org/openmrs/web/filter/initialization/InitializationFilter.java:549`: the fallback to `root`
- `openmrs-core/web/src/test/java/org/openmrs/web/filter/initialization/InitializationFilterNormalizationTest.java:1-92`: new tests asserting the underscore keys survive normalization
- `openmrs-core/web/src/test/java/org/openmrs/web/filter/initialization/InitializationFilterTest.java:163-190`: new end-to-end test feeding these env vars through `initializeWizardFromResolvedPropertiesIfPresent`
